title: Production Operations, Cloud, and Reliability
learning_outcomes: Operate cloud-hosted Linux workloads with reproducible provisioning, release strategies, monitoring, backup, and recovery.
Apply the module concepts to a safe example and verify the observed result.
Identify at least one distribution/version difference or operational safety concern.
